product.name: Aurelio Sonata 6-String Acoustic
product.description: The Aurelio Sonata 6‑String Acoustic is crafted for musicians who value a warm, resonant tone and traditional playability. A spruce top provides bright attack while mahogany back and sides deliver rich mid‑range and sustain. The rosewood fingerboard offers smooth action and a comfortable feel for both beginners and seasoned players. With a body length of 100 cm and a weight of 3.5 kg, the instrument balances portability with tonal depth. The natural wood finish showcases the grain and adds a classic aesthetic suitable for stage and studio use.
